paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: frame mid-task steering messages so the agent keeps the running task instead of treating
an interjection as a fresh instruction.
# dsh-steer-anchor
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: keep a running task on track when the user steers mid‑turn.
In DSH, a steering message (GUI: press `Ctrl+Enter` while a turn is running) is recorded as an ordin

ary
`user/message` with `source.kind === 'user'`. Only the UI projection marks it as "steering"; the

model sees
one more user message at the end of the context and tends to treat it as a fresh instruc

tion — abandoning the
running plan, redoing finished steps, or drifting off the task.
Codex's `turn/steer` has the same delivery point (input is merged into the active turn and consumed

at the next
model request). The difference is that Codex's harness prompt and model training already

establish "a mid-turn
message continues the current task". DSH has no such convention, so this plug
in adds it explicitly.

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The listener:
1. Runs only when `payload.step > 1`, i.e. the step continues an open turn. A message that opens a t

urn
(`step === 1`, including an idle steer) is left untouched.
2. Touches only messages whose `sourc

e.kind === 'user'`. Context producers that already attribute themselves —
`runtime-context`, `peer-b

us-message`, `agent-message` — are left untouched.
3. Prepends one text block with three rules; the

user's original blocks stay verbatim after it.
4. Is idempotent: a message whose first text block al
ready carries the marker is not framed again.
Because the agent loop appends the admitted pre-step decision messages to the session log, the frame

d content
is durable with the message it frames. Model-visible content therefore stays reconstructab

le from the log
(DSH's "model-visible ⟺ logged" rule), with no hidden side channel.
### Frame text
[代码示例省略，未执行]
(The rules are written in the language most of this deployment's sessions use. Edit `ANCHOR_TEXT` in
`lib/index.js` to change them.)
## Cost
One extra text block per steering message: 198 characters (~100 tokens). Nothing else — no extra mod

el calls,
no extra messages, no rewriting of history.
## Self-check
While mounted under the Web profile, the plugin serves a read-only route on the local server:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`framed` counts every framed steering message; `lastTurn` / `lastStep` name the most recent one. Ste

ering is
always claimed at `step >= 2`.
## Limitations
- Covers GUI user steering (`source.kind === 'user'`). Peer-bus and subagent messages carry their ow

n attribution
and are intentionally left alone.
- The frame appears inside the user's message bubble

— the visible price of keeping "model-visible ⟺ logged".
- The frame is guidance, not enforcement:

the model can still decide an interjection changes the goal, and the
rule explicitly allows changing

only the conflicting part.
- Text is currently fixed at the module level; no config surface yet.
